title: Service Unreachable — frontend can't reach auth-service
intro: Support tickets say login is broken. The frontend pods look healthy, but requests to auth-service are timing out.

steps.prompt: Confirm the auth-service pods are actually running.
steps.fake_output:
NAME                            READY   STATUS    RESTARTS   AGE
auth-service-5c9f7b8d4-qw3rt    1/1     Running   0          3h
auth-service-5c9f7b8d4-yu4io    1/1     Running   0          3h
steps.hint: The pods themselves might be totally fine — check first before assuming they're the problem.

steps.prompt: Pods look healthy. Check the auth-service Service object itself.
steps.fake_output:
Name: auth-service
Selector: app=auth-svc
Type: ClusterIP
IP: 10.96.12.44
Port: 8080/TCP
Endpoints: <none>
steps.hint: Look closely at the Selector line and compare it to the pod labels you just saw.

steps.prompt: Endpoints is empty — the selector says 'app=auth-svc' but the pods are labeled differently. Confirm the pods' actual labels.
steps.fake_output:
NAME                            LABELS
auth-service-5c9f7b8d4-qw3rt    app=auth-service,env=prod
auth-service-5c9f7b8d4-yu4io    app=auth-service,env=prod
steps.hint: Compare this to the service's selector you saw in the previous step.

steps.prompt: Confirmed: service selector says 'app=auth-svc' but pods are labeled 'app=auth-service' — a typo mismatch. Patch the service's selector to match.
steps.hint: You can patch the selector field directly, or edit the service manifest.

steps.prompt: Confirm the fix — check endpoints again.

resolution: Classic label/selector mismatch — the Service's selector didn't match any pod's actual labels, so it silently had zero endpoints. Nothing crashed, nothing logged an error; requests to the service just timed out with no explanation. This is exactly why 'describe svc' and checking Selector vs pod labels should be one of your first checks whenever something is 'unreachable' but pods look fine.
